description: This file is a makefile related to the OpenWrt project, handling feed configurations, package directories, and package file lists.

methods.name: FeedPackageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for a package feed, optionally considering per-feed repositories and subdirectories.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendOPKG
methods.description: Generates and appends 'opkg' source entries to a given file for the current configuration.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendAPK
methods.description: Generates and appends 'apk' source entries to a given file for the current configuration.

methods.name: GetABISuffix
methods.description: Returns the ABI suffix for a package, either from predefined variables or by formatting based on version info.

methods.name: FormatABISuffix
methods.description: Formats the ABI suffix string based on package name and ABI version.
